scope: 20 unchanged development cases plus 12 new synthetic audit cases; no prompt changes during replay; not real-source or human-gold evaluation

manual_fidelity_issues.anger: Adds disappointment with results; source only reports fury with performance.
manual_fidelity_issues.forecast: Adds an announcement happening soon without supplied timing.
manual_fidelity_issues.other: Adds delight specifically with performance; source gives no reason for delight.

new_case_observations: All 12 new cases preserve supplied speaker attribution, conditionality, negation and qualifications. Paragraph-turns retains the blank line. All five new no-current-emotion cases still produce a body.
ask_trace: Assembly asks to articulate reporting faithfully. Form permits null but does not establish an emotional relevance condition. This admits neutral reporting and source-context summaries. Do not mistake source fidelity for Influencer product sufficiency.
